messages:
maria: FYI customer ACME is seeing almost all heatmap/graph panels return empty or a 500 briefly at ~09:12 UTC. Screenshots attached in ticket.
kevin: which console route? examples?
maria: /console/v1/analytics/panels/heatmap?range=1h&series=latency — they report 500s and some timeouts. Happens across org and only in eu-west region.
kevin: got it. any request-id or trace in the screenshot?
maria: there is a header shown: X-Request-Id: req-0a1b2c3d4e, customer also pasted response body: "{\"error\":\"internal server error\"}"
jordan: tagging SRE — I see an alert from analytics-proxy at 09:11 for elevated 5xx rate (eu-west). Could be upstream ClickHouse slowdowns or aggregator pod OOM loops.
alex: I pulled analytics-proxy logs around that req id: 
```
2026-03-10T09:11:52Z [info] req=req-0a1b2c3d4e route=/panels/heatmap upstream=aggregator-v3 status=502 latency=1204ms
2026-03-10T09:11:53Z [error] aggregator-v3 timeout connecting to clickhouse cluster-secondary: dial tcp 10.4.5.67:9000: i/o timeout
```
alex: aggregator-v3 had a spike of connection timeouts to clickhouse-secondary for ~2m.
priya: any recent deploys to aggregator?
jordan: there was a small rollout of aggregator-v3 yesterday (canary) — control-plane shows 30% traffic to the new variant since 06:00 UTC.
kevin: could be a regression in connection pooling with bigger concurrency. Can we repro locally?
alex: I ran a repro curl from staging to replicate panel request:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://console.eu-west.redwood/api/console/v1/analytics/panels/heatmap?range=1h' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'
# result: 500 1.22
```
There is an aggregator stacktrace in logs referencing: ErrClickhouseConnPoolExhausted: no available connections

maria: customer wants ETA — they rely on these graphs for SLAs.
priya: immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily route eu-west console analytics traffic to aggregator-v2 (pre-rollout) via routing policy, or 2) increase clickhouse connection pool size, or 3) enable proxy fallback to pre-aggregated metrics cache. Which is fastest?
jordan: fastest is routing back to aggregator-v2 for eu-west. I can flip policy if eng-runtime approves.
alex: flip is low-risk and quick. I'll prepare an ops plan: 1) change smart-routing weight to v2=100% for eu-west, 2) monitor 5xx rate and tail latency, 3) if good, rollback canary and open a Jira to fix v3 connection pooling.
kevin: also add a short-lived feature flag to disable the new pooling code path in v3, if that helps future rollback without routing changes.
maria: customer notified about mitigation plan?
priya: I'll message ACME-ops: "We're rolling console analytics back to the previous aggregator in eu-west while we investigate; this should restore graphs within ~5-10min."
support-bot: Incident created: INC-4321 (analytics-console-euw-5xx-spike). Pager duty paged on-call. :rotating_light:
jordan: after routing change at 09:17 we saw 5xx drop to near 0 and panels recovered for the customer at 09:20. Confirmed with screenshots from ACME.
kevin: follow-ups: 1) root-cause RCA to eng-ml/eng-runtime about v3 connection pool behavior under high concurrent query mixes, 2) add synthetic check for heatmap endpoints in eu-west to catch regressions earlier, 3) ensure aggregator deploys have automated DB connection pool stress tests.
alex: creating jira: RED-8421 "aggregator-v3 clickhouse connection pool exhaustion under concurrent heatmap queries" and will link logs + repro steps.
priya: closing loop with customer and offering a 1-week dashboard data retention check.
maria: thanks team — good quick response. Please paste postmortem link here when ready. :thumbsup:
